_doc: KOF95 ground truth captured from the running game (MAME, capture/*.lua, 2026-10-02). Animation slots are indices into the character's state table at $080000 + id*4; each animation's own terminator decides loop ($FF00) or play-once-and-hold ($FE00). Physics in px/frame (fixed point in the game); y is height above the floor. Phase lengths in frames are the game's own.

ram._doc: Character objects: P1 $108100, P2 $108300, $200 bytes each.

game_states._doc: game state word (+$72) seen while each animation played (Terry, capture/terry_attack/hit*.txt)
game_states.hit: stand light 26, stand heavy 29, crouch light 30, crouch heavy 31, air 32, blowback 33, trip 34, bounce 41, down 45, getup 47
game_states.body_toss: C+D: ground 96 (slot 34), in a jump 111 (slot 35); the victim gets the blowback reaction (33 -> 41 -> 45 -> 47)
game_states.throw: close + forward + C or D: 144 (slot per character, capture/throws/<id>.json)

reactions._doc: measured on Terry (capture/terry_hit*.txt, terry_blow.txt); px/frame, y up; vx is away from the attacker. Hit-stop = the animation's first 15-tick step.

boxes._doc: animation command fd TT x y w h (signed bytes x/y, centre + half extents from the feet origin, same axis as sprite dx; the ROM's sprites face LEFT, so negative x = in front). TT>>4: 1 attack (live only on the step right after it), 3 upper hurtbox, 4 lower hurtbox (persist until replaced); low nibble varies (0/1/2) per move.
